lessons.title: English Proverbs: Wisdom and Advice
lessons.content: Proverbs are short, well-known sayings that express a general truth or piece of advice. Learning proverbs helps you understand cultural wisdom and express ideas more effectively in English.

details.concept: A leopard cannot change its spots.
details.explanation: People cannot change their fundamental nature.
details.example: He promised to be more patient, but he got angry again. A leopard cannot change its spots.
details.burmese: လူတစ်ယောက်ရဲ့ မူလသဘာဝကို ပြောင်းလဲလို့မရဘူး။

details.concept: A fool and his money are soon parted.
details.explanation: A foolish person quickly loses their money.
details.example: He bought another useless gadget. A fool and his money are soon parted.
details.burmese: အသိဥာဏ်နည်းတဲ့လူက ငွေကိုမြန်မြန်ဆုံးရှုံးတတ်တယ်။

details.concept: A barking dog seldom bites.
details.explanation: People who make loud threats rarely carry them out.
details.example: Don't worry about his threats. A barking dog seldom bites.
details.burmese: အော်ဟစ်ခြိမ်းခြောက်တတ်တဲ့လူက ရှားရှားပါးပါး လုပ်တတ်တယ်။

details.concept: A mouse may help a lion.
details.explanation: Even small or weak beings can help the powerful.
details.example: Don't underestimate the new intern. A mouse may help a lion.
details.burmese: အားနည်းတဲ့လူက အားကြီးတဲ့လူကို ကူညီနိုင်တယ်။

details.concept: A friend to all is a friend to none.
details.explanation: Someone who tries to be friends with everyone truly has no real friends.
details.example: He talks to everyone but no one trusts him. A friend to all is a friend to none.
details.burmese: အားလုံးနဲ့ သူငယ်ချင်းဖြစ်ချင်တဲ့လူက တကယ့်သူငယ်ချင်းမရှိဘူး။

details.concept: All that glitters is not gold.
details.explanation: Something that looks valuable or attractive may not be so.
details.example: That job offer looks amazing, but check the details. All that glitters is not gold.
details.burmese: တောက်ပတဲ့အရာအားလုံး ရွှေမဟုတ်ဘူး။

details.concept: All covet, all lose.
details.explanation: Greed causes people to lose everything.
details.example: He tried to invest in every opportunity and lost everything. All covet, all lose.
details.burmese: တစ်ခုတည်းကို လိုချင်ရင် ဆုံးရှုံးတတ်တယ်။

details.concept: Blood is thicker than water.
details.explanation: Family relationships are stronger than other relationships.
details.example: After all the arguments, they still helped each other. Blood is thicker than water.
details.burmese: သွေးသားဆက်ဆံက ရေထက်ပိုထူတယ်။

details.concept: Better late than never.
details.explanation: It is better to do something late than not at all.
details.example: She finally apologized. Better late than never.
details.burmese: နောက်ကျပေမယ့် မလုပ်တာထက်ပိုကောင်းတယ်။

details.concept: Bad news travels fast.
details.explanation: Negative information spreads quickly.
details.example: Everyone already knows about the mistake. Bad news travels fast.

details.concept: Charity begins at home.
details.explanation: One should take care of family first before helping others.
details.example: He donates to strangers but ignores his parents. Charity begins at home.
details.burmese: ကျေးဇူးပြုခြင်းက အိမ်မှာစတင်တယ်။

details.concept: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
details.explanation: Do not criticize or find fault with something given to you for free.
details.example: The old car they gave you works fine. Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
details.burmese: လက်ဆောင်ရတဲ့မြင်းရဲ့ပါးစပ်ကို မကြည့်ပါနဲ့။

details.concept: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
details.explanation: Do not risk everything on a single plan or opportunity.
details.example: Apply to many schools, not just one. Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
details.burmese: ဥအုန်းအားလုံးကို ခြင်းတစ်ခုထဲမှာ မထားပါနဲ့။

details.concept: Don't judge a book by its cover.
details.explanation: Do not judge something or someone by outward appearance alone.
details.example: The small restaurant has the best food. Don't judge a book by its cover.
details.burmese: စာအုပ်ရဲ့အဖုံးကြည့်ပြီး မတရားပါနဲ့။

details.concept: Easier said than done.
details.explanation: Something is much harder to do than to talk about.
details.example: Just quit smoking? Easier said than done.
details.burmese: ပြောတာ လုပ်တာထက် လွယ်တယ်။

details.concept: Empty vessels make the greatest song.
details.explanation: People with little knowledge often talk the most.
details.example: He talks the most but knows the least. Empty vessels make the greatest song.
details.burmese: အလွတ်ဗူးက အကြီးဆုံးအသံထွက်တယ်။

details.concept: Every cloud has a silver lining.
details.explanation: There is something good in every bad situation.
details.example: Losing that job led to a better one. Every cloud has a silver lining.

details.concept: Easy come, easy go.
details.explanation: What is gained easily is lost easily.
details.example: He won the lottery and spent it all in a week. Easy come, easy go.
details.burmese: လွယ်လွယ်ရတာ လွယ်လွယ်ဆုံးရှုံးတယ်။

details.concept: Familiarity breeds contempt.
details.explanation: Too much closeness leads to a lack of respect.
details.example: They argue all the time now. Familiarity breeds contempt.
details.burmese: ရင်းနှီးမှုက အထင်အမြင်သေးခြင်းကို ဖန်တီးတယ်။

details.concept: Fools are wise as long as silent.
details.explanation: A fool seems wise when they do not speak.
details.example: He stayed quiet during the meeting. Fools are wise as long as silent.
details.burmese: အသံမထွက်သရွယ် ပါးစပ်မရှိသလို ဉာဏ်ကောင်းတယ်။

details.concept: Gardens are not made by sitting in the shade.
details.explanation: Success requires effort and hard work.
details.example: You need to study if you want to pass. Gardens are not made by sitting in the shade.
details.burmese: ဥယျာဉ်ကို အရိပ်ထဲမှာ ထိုင်ပြီး ဖန်တီးလို့မရဘူး။

details.concept: Grasp all, lose all.
details.explanation: If you try to hold on to everything, you will lose everything.
details.example: He took on too many projects and failed them all. Grasp all, lose all.

details.concept: Hatred is as blind as love.
details.explanation: Hatred, like love, can cloud a person's judgment.
details.example: He attacked his rival without thinking. Hatred is as blind as love.
details.burmese: အမုန်းက ချစ်ခြင်းလောက် မျက်စိကန်းတယ်။

details.concept: Ignorance is bliss.
details.explanation: Not knowing something can sometimes make you happier.
details.example: I don't want to know the spoilers. Ignorance is bliss.
details.burmese: မသိခြင်းက ပျော်ရွှင်ခြင်းပဲ။

details.concept: If you want a friend, be a friend.
details.explanation: To have friends, you must first be a good friend.
details.example: Be kind to others if you want them to be kind to you. If you want a friend, be a friend.
details.burmese: သူငယ်ချင်းလိုချင်ရင် သူငယ်ချင်းဖြစ်ပါ။

details.concept: Keep something for a rainy day.
details.explanation: Save resources for a time of need.
details.example: Don't spend all your salary. Keep something for a rainy day.
details.burmese: မိုးရွာတဲ့နေ့အတွက် တစ်ခုခုထားပါ။

details.concept: Kill the goose that lays the golden eggs.
details.explanation: Destroy something that produces valuable results for you.
details.example: He fired his best worker and the company suffered. He killed the goose that lays the golden eggs.
details.burmese: ရွှေဥဥတဲ့ ဘဲကြက်ကို သတ်ပစ်တယ်။

details.concept: Living well is the best revenge.
details.explanation: The best response to those who wrong you is to live happily.
details.example: After the breakup, she focused on her career. Living well is the best revenge.

details.concept: Look after number one.
details.explanation: Take care of yourself first.
details.example: You can't help others if you're exhausted. Look after number one.
details.burmese: ပထမဦးစားပေး ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို ဂရုစိုက်ပါ။

details.concept: Lend only that which you can afford to lose.
details.explanation: Only lend what you can afford not to get back.
details.example: I only lend small amounts. Lend only that which you can afford to lose.

details.concept: Make hay while the sun shines.
details.explanation: Take advantage of favorable conditions while they last.
details.example: Business is booming now, so expand. Make hay while the sun shines.
details.burmese: နေရောင်ရှိတုန်း မြက်ခြောက်လှပ်ပါ။

details.concept: Might is right.
details.explanation: The powerful determine what is considered right.
details.example: The stronger country won the dispute. Might is right.
details.burmese: အားကြီးတာက မှန်တယ်။

details.concept: Mind your own business.
details.explanation: Do not interfere in other people's affairs.
details.example: Stop asking about my salary. Mind your own business.
details.burmese: ကိုယ့်အလုပ်ကိုယ်လုပ်ပါ။

details.concept: More haste, less speed.
details.explanation: Going too fast leads to mistakes and slows you down.
details.example: Take your time with the assignment. More haste, less speed.
details.burmese: အလျင်စောလေ အနှေးပိုလေ။

details.concept: One rotten apple spoils the whole bunch.
details.explanation: One bad person can negatively influence an entire group.
details.example: One lazy student affected the whole class. One rotten apple spoils the whole bunch.
details.burmese: ပုပ်သောအသီးတစ်လုံးက အုပ်စုတစ်ခုလုံးကို ပျက်စေတယ်။

details.concept: Opportunity seldom knocks twice.
details.explanation: Good opportunities are rare and should be seized.
details.example: Apply for the scholarship now. Opportunity seldom knocks twice.
details.burmese: အခွင့်အရေးက ရှားရှားပါးပါးလာတတ်တယ်။

details.concept: Out of sight, out of mind.
details.explanation: When something is not seen, it is easily forgotten.
details.example: I haven't thought about my old school in years. Out of sight, out of mind.
details.burmese: မျက်မှောက်မှာ မရှိရင် စိတ်ထဲက ပျောက်သွားတယ်။

details.concept: Prevention is better than cure.
details.explanation: It is better to stop something bad from happening than to fix it later.
details.example: Get vaccinated now. Prevention is better than cure.
details.burmese: ကာကွယ်ခြင်းက ကုသခြင်းထက် ပိုကောင်းတယ်။

details.concept: Rome was not built in a day.
details.explanation: Important achievements take time and patience.
details.example: Learning a language takes years. Rome was not built in a day.

details.concept: Solitude is often the best company.
details.explanation: Being alone can be more enjoyable than being with others.
details.example: She enjoys reading alone. Solitude is often the best company.
details.burmese: တစ်ယောက်တည်းနေခြင်းက အကောင်းဆုံးအဖော်ဖြစ်တတ်တယ်။

details.concept: The longest night will have an end.
details.explanation: Even the most difficult times will eventually pass.
details.example: Don't give up during hard times. The longest night will have an end.
details.burmese: အရှည်ဆုံးညက အဆုံးရှိတယ်။

details.concept: The pen is mightier than the sword.
details.explanation: Words and ideas have more influence than violence.
details.example: The protest was peaceful but changed the law. The pen is mightier than the sword.
details.burmese: ဘောပင်က ဓားထက် ပိုအားကြီးတယ်။

details.concept: The last straw breaks the camel's back.
details.explanation: A small final burden causes something to fail.
details.example: After years of stress, one more problem made her quit. The last straw breaks the camel's back.

details.concept: The early bird catches the worm.
details.explanation: Success comes to those who act early and prepare well.
details.example: She got the job because she applied first. The early bird catches the worm.
details.burmese: အစောပိုင်းငှက်က ပုရွက်ဆိတ်ကို ဖမ်းမိတယ်။

details.concept: Time cures all ills.
details.explanation: Given enough time, problems and suffering will fade.
details.example: You'll feel better after a few months. Time cures all ills.
details.burmese: အချိန်က အနာတရအားလုံးကို ကုသပေးတယ်။

details.concept: There is a time to speak and a time to be silent.
details.explanation: It is important to know when to talk and when to stay quiet.
details.example: During the negotiation, she chose her words carefully. There is a time to speak and a time to be silent.
details.burmese: ပြောရမယ့်အချိန်ရှိတယ်၊ ငြိမ်နေရမယ့်အချိန်ရှိတယ်။

details.concept: There is truth in wine.
details.explanation: People reveal their true feelings when they are drunk.
details.example: He confessed his love after drinking. There is truth in wine.
details.burmese: စပျစ်ရည်ထဲမှာ မှန်ကန်မှုရှိတယ်။

details.concept: When in Rome do as Romans do.
details.explanation: When in a new place, follow the customs of the people there.
details.example: In Japan, you remove your shoes indoors. When in Rome do as Romans do.
details.burmese: ရောမမှာနေရင် ရောမလူတွေလို လုပ်ပါ။

details.concept: What will be, will be.
details.explanation: The future is determined and cannot be changed.
details.example: Don't worry too much about tomorrow. What will be, will be.
details.burmese: ဖြစ်မည့်အရာက ဖြစ်မှာပဲ။

details.concept: What's done is done.
details.explanation: The past cannot be changed, so move on.
details.example: Stop regretting the past. What's done is done.

details.concept: Words have wings and cannot be recalled.
details.explanation: Once spoken, words cannot be taken back.
details.example: Think before you speak. Words have wings and cannot be recalled.
details.burmese: စကားက အတောင်ရှိပြီး ပြန်မခေါ်နိုင်ဘူး။

details.concept: Words cut more than swords.
details.explanation: Hurtful words cause deeper wounds than physical weapons.
details.example: His insults hurt her deeply. Words cut more than swords.
details.burmese: စကားက ဓားထက် ပိုဖြတ်တယ်။

details.concept: You can't take it with you when you die.
details.explanation: Material wealth cannot be taken to the afterlife.
details.example: Enjoy life now, not just working. You can't take it with you when you die.
details.burmese: သေတဲ့အခါ ဘာမှ မခေါ်သွားနိုင်ဘူး။

details.concept: You can't please everyone.
details.explanation: It is impossible to satisfy every person.
details.example: Some people liked the movie, others didn't. You can't please everyone.
details.burmese: အားလုံးကို ကျေနပ်အောင် လုပ်လို့မရဘူး။

details.concept: You can't make an omelette without breaking egg.
details.explanation: Achieving something worthwhile requires sacrifice.
details.example: Starting a business is risky. You can't make an omelette without breaking egg.
details.burmese: ဥကြက်ကြော်လုပ်ဖို့ ဥကွဲအောင် လုပ်ရတယ်။
